$Comment: The Jack Shield, the shield of the Hallowed set. Parent is the game's shield template, so it guards, bashes and spends stamina like the game's wooden shield (the template's guard StaminaCost Value 12; the Flaming Jack Shield writes a higher one); this file changes its look, name, quality and the stats it gives (Utility.StatModifiers). The game applies those to the shield in the utility slot and the library applies them to a held one, so they count wherever the shield is equipped, main hand or utility slot. One shield counts at a time: a shield in the main hand is not Utility.Compatible, so while one is held the game leaves the utility slot's stats off and two shields never stack. That includes its boost to favor gained with the Hallowed, the percent on the stat TrackGain_Hallows_Eve_Hallowed (10 is +10%), and its fire resistance, the library's DamageResist_Fire in whole percent points (5 resists a twentieth of every fire hit, burns included; the library turns the stat into the game's own resistance, capped by DamageResistMax). The tooltip lists each stat by its name. The set counts it only in the utility slot, never in the main hand.
